description: This file defines the Java class 'ModifyPolicyIdResponse', which represents the response to a 'ModifyPolicyId' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It contains methods for creating instances based on different HTTP statuses, parsing JSON responses, and accessing response data such as the associated Thing ID and Policy ID.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyIdResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response to a 'ModifyPolicyId' command, encapsulating details such as thing and policy IDs, status, headers, and JSON serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating successful creation of a policy ID with HTTP status 201 (CREATED). It has overloaded versions accepting String or ThingId and PolicyId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a successful policy ID modification with HTTP status 204 (NO_CONTENT). It has overloaded versions accepting String or ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory methods to parse a JSON string or JSON object into a 'ModifyPolicyIdResponse' instance, extracting relevant fields and deserializing according to the response type.
